description: Detect video cuts and scene transitions. Returns structured timestamps, scene durations, and cut boundaries as JSON, with optional contact-sheet image preview for vision models.

includeBase64.description: Return base64 contact sheet image data in response for vision models when outputPath is specified. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video file to analyze for scene transitions.

minDurationSeconds.description: Minimum scene duration in seconds to filter out rapid flashes or micro-cuts. Default: 0.5.

outputPath.description: Optional destination path for a contact-sheet montage image (.png or .jpg) visualizing detected scenes.

threshold.description: Scene cut sensitivity threshold between 0.05 and 1.0. Lower values detect subtle transitions; higher values detect only dramatic scene cuts. Default: 0.3.

name: detect_scenes
